integrity: The result has a complete abstract proof, explicit constructions, and a standalone finite checker with its original recorded output; it has not received independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Theorem assumes finite connected simple graphs and real coefficients; the stronger claim about all noninvertible homomorphisms is not proved. Small-graph enumeration supports but cannot prove the general result. Historical literature coverage is necessarily incomplete.
title: Singular false-twin quotients and the real graph evolution-algebra isomorphism criterion
